title: Trump’s Chinese tariffs could reduce Apple revenues by 5%, profit by 1%, says analyst
text: Trump’s Chinese tariffs could reduce Apple revenues by 5%, profit by 1%, says analyst Monday, 10 September 2018 ( 9 hours ago ) Trump’s latest proposal for the administration’s trade war with China would see a 25% tariff imposed on a number of Apple products, among them the Apple Pencil, AirPods, Apple Watch and Mac mini. That’s already hit the share price of a number of Apple suppliers, but now an analyst has estimated the likely impact on the Cupertino company itself … more… ▶ Apple Shares Slide Over Proposed Tariff Concerns 00:37 According to Business Insider, Apple shares slid during Monday morning trading. After President Donald Trump proposed even more tariffs on Chinese imports last week, Apple warned that a wide range of their products would go up in price.
